parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The slew rate of an ideal operational amplifier (op-amp) is said to be infinite.
Explain what is meant by infinite slew rate.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
The circuit of Fig. 6.1 is designed to indicate whether the temperature of the thermistor is above or below $24\degree\text{C}$.

{{figure:figure_6_1.png}}

The operational amplifier (op-amp) is assumed to be ideal.

At $24\degree\text{C}$, the resistance of the thermistor is $1.50\text{ k}\Omega$.
parts.text:
Determine the resistance of resistor $R$ such that the output $V_{\text{OUT}}$ of the op-amp changes at $24\degree\text{C}$.

(Ω)

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
On Fig. 6.1,
1.
draw two light-emitting diodes (LEDs) connected so as to indicate whether the
output $V_{\mathrm{OUT}}$ of the op-amp is either +5 V or −5 V,
2.
label with the letter G the LED that will be emitting light when the temperature is
below 24 °C. Explain your working.
